**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/21 (Tue) 05:16  
[FACT] User sells handmade jewelry and candles.  
[EVENT] User had a conversation with a local boutique owner at the Spring Fling Market yesterday.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on how to follow up with a potential wholesale customer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Following up with potential wholesale customers is crucial to turning a promising conversation into a successful partnership.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested sending a thank-you note or email within 24 hours to express gratitude for their time and interest in products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example thank-you note: "Hi [Boutique Owner's Name], I wanted to thank you again for stopping by my booth at the Spring Fling Market yesterday. It was great chatting with you, and I'm excited about the possibility of working together."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended reiterating the benefits of the products, highlighting unique selling points, and how they can benefit the boutique and customers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested attaching a wholesale catalog or line sheet with product images, descriptions, pricing, and ordering information.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example message for catalog attachment: "I've attached my wholesale catalog for your review. Please let me know if you have any questions or if there's anything specific you'd like to discuss further."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised offering a special promotion or incentive, such as a limited-time discount or free shipping.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example promotion: "As a special offer, I'd like to provide 10% off your first wholesale order. Just use the code SPRINGFLING10 at checkout."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested showcasing products in a lifestyle setting with high-quality images.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended being prepared to answer questions and provide additional information to build trust and confidence.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised following up again if necessary, with a friendly follow-up email if no response is received within a week or two.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example follow-up message: "Hi [Boutique Owner's Name], I wanted to follow up on our conversation at the Spring Fling Market. I understand you must be busy, but I wanted to check in and see if you're still interested in discussing a wholesale partnership."  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking about their pricing strategy and wants to ensure competitive pricing for their jewelry and candles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested identifying competitors and analyzing their prices by visiting websites, social media, or market stalls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended noting pricing ranges (lowest, average, highest) for similar products.
